product.title: Our Products
product.description: Discover our range of high-quality industrial products and solutions.

helicalGear.title: Helical Gear
helicalGear.description: A high-precision mechanical helical gear manufactured from wear-resistant steel. Its angled teeth provide gradual and smooth engagement, ensuring quiet operation, high load-carrying capacity, and efficient power transmission across a wide range of industrial and mechanical applications.

bevelGear.title: Bevel Gear
bevelGear.description: A high-quality bevel gear manufactured from stress- and wear-resistant steel, featuring an angled conical design for efficient power and torque transmission between intersecting shafts.

wormGearSet.title: Worm Gear Set
wormGearSet.description: A high-precision worm gear drive set featuring a hardened worm screw and corrosion-resistant brass worm wheel. Designed for high speed reduction, increased torque, and compact operation, with self-locking capability for industrial lifting, conveying, and drive systems.

gearBox.title: Gear Box
gearBox.description: High-precision mechanical gearbox gears designed to deliver reliable and efficient performance. Manufactured from high-strength steel alloys for enhanced durability, wear resistance, and load-bearing capacity. Available in various gear ratios for efficient power and torque transmission, making them suitable for automotive applications, industrial equipment, and heavy machinery.

ConcealedValve.title: Concealed Valve Cartridge
ConcealedValve.description: A brass internal mechanical component designed to control the opening, closing, and water flow within concealed plumbing valves installed inside walls, ensuring reliable and smooth operation of the water system.

brassKnurled.title: Brass Knurled Nut
brassKnurled.description: High-quality brass knurled nut designed for easy and flexible hand tightening and adjustment without the need for tools.

brassThread.title: Brass Threaded Sleeve
brassThread.description: High-precision brass threaded sleeve manufactured using CNC machining to ensure dimensional accuracy and durability. Features an extended external thread for secure connections and a knurled end for easy installation and removal with tools, making it suitable for fluid systems, industrial sprinklers, and high-pressure equipment.

brassTHandle.title: Brass T-Handle Valve Stem
brassTHandle.description: High-quality brass valve stem manufactured using CNC machining for precise dimensions and reliable sealing. Features a T-handle for smooth manual opening and closing, a precision-machined thread, and a high-resistance rubber gasket to prevent fluid leakage under pressure. Suitable for industrial piping systems, water valves, and engineering equipment.

stainlessSteelTactileDiscs.title: Stainless Steel Tactile Discs
stainlessSteelTactileDiscs.description: High-precision stainless steel control discs and caps manufactured using CNC turning and milling for durability and corrosion resistance. Featuring a diamond-knurled surface pattern for enhanced grip and slip resistance, making them suitable for control panels, machinery, precision adjustment knobs, and engineering applications.
